about_the_game:
Welcome aboard the Driftwood Diner! Embark on a culinary adventure as you run your very own restaurant on a boat. After losing your home in a forest fire, you're determined to earn money and help rebuild your community.

Master The Cook

Cook up some comfort food from your boat-side kitchen. Master the timing and tools of your kitchen to keep orders flowing and customers happy!

Cast Your Line

Cast a line and catch your customers dinner. Use Timing and Skill to hook a fish, and expand your menu with your latest catch.

Grow Your Grub

Plant, water and harvest your own ingredients! Balance your time between cooking and cultivating by growing rare crops for new dishes.

Serve delicious meals, explore new waters, and bring joy to your customers as you sail from port to port. Every dish you create brings you one step closer to rebuilding your community. The Driftwood Diner is open — and your story is just beginning!

Developer Note

Hey! Thanks so much for checking out the game! I am a solo developer working on making this game the best it can possible be. I received a lot of support and great comments from the community to help shape it into a game hopefully everyone would love. If you are interested in joining the community consider joining the discord and letting me know what you think of the game so far!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or greater
  • Processor: 2.0GHz
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Direct X 9.0c compliant video card with 512 MB of RAM
  • Storage: 5 GB available space

short_description: Manage your diner’s food supply as you sail from port to port serving up delicious cuisine and growing your own ingredients. Raise as much funds as you can to rebuild your community before it's too late. So grab your apron, fire up the stove, and get cooking!
